mapper.select: /** saleson.shop.welfarecenter.SlaveOffgiveMapper.getManagerRequestDetails (관리자 권한 승인관리 상세 조회) */ SELECT A.USER_ID ,A.REQST_SN ,CRYPTO_DEC('normal', LOGIN_ID, '', 0) AS LOGIN_ID ,A.LOCGOV_CODE ,A.REQST_SE_CODE ,A.PSITN_CODE ,A.PSITN_NM ,A.PSITN_DEPT_NM ,CRYPTO_DEC('normal', OFCPS_NM, '', 0) AS OFCPS_NM ,CRYPTO_DEC('normal', CTTPC, '', 0) AS CTTPC ,A.CONFM_STTUS_CODE ,A.REJECT_RESN ,A.FRST_REGISTER_ID ,A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,A.LAST_UPDUSR_ID ,A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ,CRYPTO_DEC('normal', USER_NAME, '', 0) AS USER_NAME ,CRYPTO_DEC('normal', EMAIL, '', 0) AS EMAIL ,CRYPTO_DEC('normal', PHONE_NUMBER, '', 0) AS PHONE_NUMBER ,CRYPTO_DEC('normal', BIRTHDAY, '', 0) AS BIRTHDAY ,A.RECEIVE_EMAIL ,A.CONFM_STTUS_NM ,A.REQST_SE_NM ,A.LOCGOV_NM ,A.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM ,A.BANK_NM ,A.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE ,A.DSGNCNTR_PART_ID , A.MANAGER_LOCGOV_CODE , A.REQ_DSGNCNTR_PART_ID , A.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_NM FROM ( SELECT R.USER_ID, R.REQST_SN, R.LOGIN_ID, R.LOCGOV_CODE, R.REQST_SE_CODE, R.PSITN_CODE, R.PSITN_NM, R.PSITN_DEPT_NM, R.OFCPS_NM, R.CTTPC, R.CONFM_STTUS_CODE, R.REJECT_RESN, R.FRST_REGISTER_ID, DATE_FORMAT(R.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM, R.LAST_UPDUSR_ID, DATE_FORMAT(R.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM, U.USER_NAME, U.EMAIL, UD.PHONE_NUMBER, UD.BIRTHDAY, UD.RECEIVE_EMAIL, C1.LABEL AS CONFM_STTUS_NM, C2.LABEL AS REQST_SE_NM, C3.LABEL AS LOCGOV_NM, C4.LABEL AS UPPER_LOCGOV_NM, C5.LABEL AS BANK_NM, CONCAT(SUBSTR(R.LOCGOV_CODE, 1, 2), '000') AS UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE, NVL(DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID, 0) AS DSGNCNTR_PART_ID, M.LOCGOV_CODE AS MANAGER_LOCGOV_CODE , NVL(DPUM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID, 0) AS REQ_DSGNCNTR_PART_ID , G.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_NM FROM G_MNGR_REQST R INNER JOIN OP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = R.USER_ID INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON UD.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C1 ON C1.CODE_TYPE = 'CFM_STATUS' AND C1.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C1.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C1.ID = R.CONFM_STTUS_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C2 ON C2.CODE_TYPE = 'REQST_SE_CODE' AND C2.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C2.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C2.ID = R.REQST_SE_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C3 ON C3.CODE_TYPE = 'LOCGOV_CODE' AND C3.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C3.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C3.ID = R.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C4 ON C4.CODE_TYPE = 'WDR' AND C4.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C4.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C4.ID = CONCAT(SUBSTR(R.LOCGOV_CODE, 1, 2), '000') LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C5 ON C5.CODE_TYPE = 'OFF_BANK_LIST' AND C5.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C5.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C5.ID = R.PSITN_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_MNGR_MPNG DPUM ON U.USER_ID = DPUM.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_MANAGER M ON U.USER_ID = M.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN G_DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_MNG DPM ON DPUM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID = DPM.DSGN_DNTN_BIZ_DEPT_ID AND DPM.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.LOCGOV_CODE = DPM.LCLGV_CD INNER JOIN G_LCLGV_PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_MNG G ON R.PSITN_CODE = G.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.REQST_SN = #{reqstSn} ) A

/** welfarecenter-mapper.getWlfrCntrMngHistory (관리자 권한 승인관리 이력 조회) */ SELECT A.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,A.REQST_SE_CODE ,A.REQST_SE_NM ,A.CONFM_STTUS_NM ,A.UPD_ID_ROLE ,A.LOGIN_ID ,A.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(R.FRST_REGIST_PNTTM,'%Y-%m-%d') AS FRST_REGIST_PNTTM ,REQST_SE_CODE ,( CASE WHEN R.REQST_SE_CODE = 'ROLE_ADMIN_11' THEN CONCAT(C4.LABEL, '', C3.LABEL) ELSE C2.LABEL END ) AS REQST_SE_NM ,C1.LABEL AS CONFM_STTUS_NM ,( SELECT ROLE_NAME FROM OP_ROLE OROLE INNER JOIN OP_USER_ROLE OUR ON OROLE.AUTHORITY = OUR.AUTHORITY AND OUR.AUTHORITY LIKE 'ROLE_ADMIN%' WHERE OUR.USER_ID = R.LAST_UPDUSR_ID AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS UPD_ID_ROLE ,( CASE WHEN R.CONFM_STTUS_CODE != '200' THEN CRYPTO_DEC('normal', U.LOGIN_ID, '', 0) ELSE NULL END) AS LOGIN_ID ,DATE_FORMAT(R.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ,'%Y-%m-%d') AS LAST_UPDT_PNTTM FROM G_MNGR_REQST R INNER JOIN OP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = R.last_updusr_id INNER JOIN OP_USER_DETAIL UD ON UD.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C1 ON C1.CODE_TYPE = 'CFM_STATUS' AND C1.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C1.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C1.ID = R.CONFM_STTUS_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C2 ON C2.CODE_TYPE = 'REQST_SE_CODE' AND C2.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C2.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C2.ID = R.REQST_SE_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C3 ON C3.CODE_TYPE = 'LOCGOV_CODE' AND C3.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C3.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C3.ID = R.LOCGOV_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C4 ON C4.CODE_TYPE = 'WDR' AND C4.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C4.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C4.ID = CONCAT(SUBSTR(R.LOCGOV_CODE, 1, 2), '000') LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_COMMON_CODE C5 ON C5.CODE_TYPE = 'OFF_BANK_LIST' AND C5.USE_YN = 'Y' AND C5.LANGUAGE = 'ko' AND C5.ID = R.PSITN_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN OP_USER_ROLE UR ON UR.USER_ID = R.USER_ID AND UR.AUTHORITY = 'ROLE_ADMIN_11' INNER JOIN G_LCLGV_PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_MNG G ON R.PSITN_CODE = G.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_ID WHERE R.USER_ID = #{userId} AND R.REQST_SE_CODE = 'ROLE_ADMIN_11' ORDER BY R.LAST_UPDT_PNTTM DESC ) A

SELECT A.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_ID , B.UPPER_LOCGOV_CODE , A.LCLGV_CD , B.UPPER_LOCGOV_NM , B.LOCGOV_NM , A.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_NM , A.PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_CD , A.USE_YN , A.FRST_REG_DT FROM G_LCLGV_PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_MNG A LEFT OUTER JOIN G_LOCGOV B ON A.LCLGV_CD = B.LOCGOV_CODE WHERE 1 = 1 AND PBADMS_WLFR_CNTR_ID = #{pbadmsWlfrCntrId}
